tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the shell. Documents use bg-surface as the paper.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: The shell and the paper of client documents.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, table headers, the document header block.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Tags, code, pressed wells.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px borders on shell, cards, tables, tags; section-title underline.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on any bg-* token.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Prose, subtitles, table notes, footer text.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and decorative marks only. Not for reading text: it is below 4.5:1 on bg-surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Yellow. Dark-theme focus ring, document eyebrow labels and header top rule. Light value is 3.3:1 on paper: only 11px bold uppercase labels and rules, as the handoff PDF uses it, never body text. Use accent-text for text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Yellow as text at any size: active rows, labels, focus rings and field borders on focus. Dark is accent. Light is a deepened yellow, 5.2:1 on bg-surface and 4.7:1 on bg-raised, where accent itself is only 3.3:1.

tokens.name: accent-alt
tokens.usage: Green. Light-theme button fill, section-title icons, checkmarks, the 'computing' half of the wordmark. Light value is 4.3:1 on paper: fine for the bold wordmark and icons, not for small body text.

tokens.name: accent-cool
tokens.usage: Blue. Links, IPs, handles and contact details.

tokens.name: accent-warm
tokens.usage: Orange. 'Heads up' callouts, warnings and danger: the palette has no red that reads on raised surfaces, so destructive buttons and errors use this.

tokens.name: accent-rose
tokens.usage: Purple. Secondary tags and character accents.

tokens.name: accent-aqua
tokens.usage: Aqua. Success and 'done' states.

tokens.name: accent-aqua-text
tokens.usage: Aqua as text: speech in roleplay prose, success messages. Dark is accent-aqua. Light is darkened, 5.5:1 on bg-surface and 5.0:1 on bg-raised, where accent-aqua is 4.4:1 and 4.0:1.

tokens.name: btn-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: yellow in dark, green in light.

tokens.name: btn-fg
tokens.usage: Text on btn-bg.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono", "Cascadia Code", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name. 'cave' in fg, 'computing' in accent-alt. Sans at 22px in document headers.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Card and section headings on the site.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and table headers in client documents, in accent.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Title of a handoff reference or invoice.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Body and table text in documents.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Self-hosted, single-user, with a little Discord inspiration.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Cozy is an app for AI roleplay.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: tag padding, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Section-title gap and underline offset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap below section titles; page side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between major sections.

tokens.name: shell-gap
tokens.usage: The app frame: the gap between the window edge and the shell, on every side and on phones too.

tokens.name: app-space-1
tokens.usage: App density: hairline gaps, icon rows, chip gaps.

tokens.name: app-space-2
tokens.usage: App density: within a control, label to field.

tokens.name: app-space-3
tokens.usage: App density: between controls in a row, rows in a group.

tokens.name: app-space-4
tokens.usage: App density: padding inside a card, panel or flyout.

tokens.name: app-space-5
tokens.usage: App density: between cards; the page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: app-space-6
tokens.usage: App density: the page gutter on desktop; a major group break; the fade above a docked composer.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height on desktop, bottom rule included.

tokens.name: topbar-height-phone
tokens.usage: Top bar height at 600px and below.

tokens.name: topbar-pad-start
tokens.usage: Top bar padding on the left, before the first item (the logo's left edge). Same as app-space-5.

tokens.name: topbar-pad-end
tokens.usage: Top bar padding on the right, after the last item. Same as app-space-4.

tokens.name: topbar-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between top bar items. Same as app-space-2.

tokens.name: topbar-brand-gap
tokens.usage: Extra space after the brand (logo and wordmark) before the next item.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Search box and primary buttons in the top bar, so their edges line up.

tokens.name: icon-btn-size
tokens.usage: Icon-only buttons in the top bar on desktop.

tokens.name: icon-btn-size-phone
tokens.usage: Icon-only buttons in the top bar at 600px and below: the tap target.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, focus rings.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The outer shell and document header.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The shell.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and primary buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover on cards and buttons.
